name: Arshad Sial
full_role: Broadcast Editor and Viewing Information Researcher
description: Arshad Sial covers CPL broadcast rights, legal streaming routes and territory-by-territory viewing information.
bio: Arshad Sial manages the CPL Season broadcast desk. His work tracks confirmed television partners, streaming services and viewing availability across the Caribbean and overseas markets.
Broadcast rights can change by territory and platform. He separates confirmed coverage from pending markets and avoids presenting an unofficial stream as an authorized option.
coverage_focus: TV partners, legal streams and regional availability
method: Checks broadcaster-owned pages and current CPL announcements.
Labels unconfirmed territories instead of guessing a platform.
Reviews viewing information when rights or service availability changes.
